abyssal lighthouse keeper, far-future, rendered as ink and wash concept art moodboard, warm amber highlights rolling into cool slate shadows, brushed aluminium

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: high-contrast teal-and-orange with protected mid-tone skin. Lighting reference: hard low sun raking across the surface with long cast shadows.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
